{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing a consistent lag of approximately 0.2-0.4 on day 1 and 0.1-0.2 for subsequent days",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) aligns with model increases but model under-forecasts the magnitude, especially on days following high sentiment spikes",
    "Sentiment negative ( <0.5) causes model to over-forecast relative to true outcomes, showing delay in price correction",
    "Model prices exhibit mean-reversion bias, bottoming around 75-76 when history shows 77+ ranges, and 80+ when history supports it",
    "When sentiment is 1.00 (strong buy), model fails to capture the full price momentum, under-forecasting by 0.3-0.5 on early days",
    "The forecast lag is most pronounced on day 1 where the difference between model and true outcomes averages 0.25-0.30",
    "Model volatility is consistently lower than true outcome volatility, failing to capture price momentum swings" ]}
